_note: 4 chart definitions, validated syntactically valid via Amplitude's verify_chart_definition (project 847885). They fail to QUERY right now only because the project has zero ingested events -- Amplitude requires properties to have real data before they're queryable, even if they exist in the tracking plan. Run ingest_synthetic_events.py --send first, then these can be queried, saved as permanent charts, and assembled into a dashboard.

charts.name: Review Volume by Complaint Category
charts.purpose: Mirrors dashboard.html's churn-risk bar chart's volume axis -- which of the 9 themes generates the most complaints.

charts.name: Churn-Language Share by Category
charts.purpose: The core churn-risk signal -- of each category's reviews, how many contain explicit cancel/switch/refund language. Combine with volume share (chart above) to compute the churn-risk index outside Amplitude, same formula as mart_complaint_churn_risk.sql.

charts.name: Advanced Labs Launch Funnel
charts.purpose: Waitlist Joined -> Test Invited -> Test Completed -> Results Reviewed, the funnel defined in WHOOP_Healthcare_Product_Case_Study.docx section 2.

charts.name: Complaint Volume Over Time by Category
charts.purpose: Monthly complaint intensity per category, for overlaying against known events (5.0/MG launch, FDA letter, FDA closeout, homescreen redesign) -- mirrors the dashboard.html time series panel.
